publicFacts: renderPwshResult joins stdout and a marked stderr section
renderResult uses the same foreground shell exit marker
tool/result message receives result.content and result.isError
meta appears only when result.meta is provided
scanZstdFrames reads independent complete frame boundaries and stops at a torn final frame
Each complete frame is checksummed and independently decodable

limitations: Rendered stdout may imitate a marker; exitCodeSource preserves this weaker provenance.
Absence of a marker does not prove an exit code of zero.
Actual captured pwsh event has isError:false, no meta, and '(no output)\n[exit code: 3221225794]'.
